import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Standardize island labels (case‑insensitive)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (possible commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''))
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: it is stored as text in some rows, convert to numeric and drop implausible negatives
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'])
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    # Keep the id column as required
    return df[['penguin_id', 'species', 'island', 'bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'sex', 'year']]

def answer(df):
    # Total body mass per species
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
